changelog.message: Add GitHub firmware updates and move device pairing into a modal.
Link the Zigbee gateway and let a weak Thread child rejoin from the edge of range.
Show each sensor's Thread signal on the portal, and retry the border router if the radio is not ready yet.
Add the Matter controller and HomeKit bridge so Thread sensors update in Home.
Initial ESP32 + ICC-1-A Thread/Matter gateway scaffold (0.1.0).
